name: IEC magnetic proximity sensor: normally closed 3 wire with connector
aliases: magnetic proximity sensor Normally Closed 3 Wire with connector
summary: Magnetic proximity sensor form: Normally Closed 3 Wire with connector.
description: A magnetic proximity sensor responds to a magnetic field or a target carrying the specified magnet. This entry identifies the normally closed 3 wire with connector form in the publisher's IEC-context family.

A piston magnet or door-mounted magnet can provide a position indication without direct mechanical contact. The normally-closed designation starts with a conducting output or closed contact in the documented reference condition; operation changes that state. The three-wire form distinguishes supply, return and switching output. Confirm sourcing or sinking operation from the actual sensor circuit before connecting it to an input.

The connector variant adds a separable field interface. Keep the mating connector designation, pin numbers and cable-core mapping visible at that boundary. A magnetic sensor can contain a reed contact or powered electronics. The actual output, field orientation and contact ratings must come from the selected device.
